Elena — quick technical note and questions so the quote matches expected load:

Recommended baseline architecture (short):
- Two fully isolated standby clusters in separate VPCs (no shared admin)
- Staging environment in its own VPC with controlled peering to the active cluster for integration tests
- Optional transit gateway for controlled cross-VPC management path (encrypted, limited routes)

Tradeoffs:
- Isolation (highest) = separate VPCs + management plane segmentation -> slower automated failover (we can script promotable endpoints)
- Fast failover (lower blast radius control) = transit gateway + NAT/policy controls -> faster routing but requires stricter VPC ACL governance

To size the standby clusters I need the following from you (Samir or procurement ok to send):
1) Target steady-state QPS and 95th percentile token/sec per minute for inference during peak business hours
2) Expected daily prompt mix (percentage short responses vs long context generations)
3) Any retention/kv-cache policies that affect warm-start requirements

If you can send those numbers we will finalize the GPU-sizes in the quote and update the SoW with cutover runbooks.

cc: Monica — once we have the metrics I’ll produce a small appendix with failure-mode timings and an estimated RTO/RPO.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
